claim_used: CCR6-regulated Th17 entry through choroid plexus is required for EAE initiation.
CCL20/CCR6 signaling reported not essential in an EAE model.
GSK3050002 is a humanized IgG monoclonal antibody that neutralizes human CCL20 in psoriatic arthritis.
Neutralizing anti-CCL20 antibodies are disclosed for inflammatory and autoimmune disorders, including multiple sclerosis in patent text.
Anti-CCL20 antibody regimen around psoriatic arthritis.
CCL20 is a secreted ligand for CCR6 and recruits dendritic cells, effector/memory T cells, B cells, and Th17/Treg populations.
